title: Climate plans found to lower companies’ borrowing costs
summary: ITPN research finds debt interest rates for companies that publish full climate transition plans are 0.8 percentage points less than for those that do not

title: If Elon Musk gifts SpaceX stock through Trump Accounts, it will come with a catch
summary: Elon Musk's planned SpaceX stock donation could come with strings attached if he uses Trump Accounts. New Treasury rules limit when shares can be sold.
